verdict.rationale: The privacy policy says Instinct has "related Mac OS and mobile applications," so a first-party mobile app exists. It does not name iOS or Android or describe any features, and the product is mainly used by texting or calling it over iMessage/WhatsApp. Missing for 10: explicit iOS and Android platform confirmation, documentation of what the mobile apps can do, app-store listings, independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile apps.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: Instinct's autonomous personal assistant, the related Mac OS and mobile applications (the "App")
